title: State, A/B, preset, and profile tests
description:
Add focused unit tests for profiles/tuning catalogs, A/B state round-trip, factory preset JSON loadability, and basic audition parameter presence (CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §22–§25, validation §28 areas for preset/A-B/profile).

Before editing, inspect:
- tests/TestMain.cpp and existing tests/* Catch2 (or project) patterns
- Source/Profiles.h, Source/TuningProfiles.h APIs from j.1
- Source/StateManager.h A/B APIs from j.2
- Resources/Presets/*.json from j.3
- ParameterIDs / audition IDs used by j.4 (read-only)
- CMakeLists.txt test target already listing prior tests — prefer not editing CMake if tests/StateTests.cpp is already or auto-globbed; only write the test file unless registration is mandatory around prior conventions (if CMake must list the file, note dependency on j.4 having registered it; do not take CMake ownership here)

Implement tests/StateTests.cpp:
1) Profiles: getProfileCount() == 12; each index returns non-empty unique name matching §23 set; applyProfileDefaults on a mock/APVTS or parameter map changes expected keys without throw
2) TuningProfiles: factory tuning list non-empty; applyTuningAdjustments mutates only allowed fields (HPF/crossover/weighting/pitch/sustain/hum discrimination markers) on a test bag
3) StateManager A/B: start from known params; copyAtoB; mutate A; switch B restores B snapshot; both slots serialize into ValueTree/XML with schema_version and reload
4) Factory presets: each of the six expected JSON files exists under Resources/Presets/; juce::JSON::parse (or equivalent) succeeds; meta.name and parameters object present
5) Crossfade/bypass API smoke: after switchActiveSlot, crossfade remaining samples > 0 until cleared; bypass helper toggles without throwing
6) Keep tests deterministic; no audio hardware; no full plugin processBlock host required unless lightweight processor fixture already exists

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: tests/StateTests.cpp exists and registers multiple test cases
Profile tests assert exactly 12 profiles with unique non-empty names
Tuning tests assert factory tunings exist and applyTuningAdjustments runs without throw
A/B tests assert copy/switch/serialize-restore of slots including schema_version
Factory preset tests assert the six expected JSON files parse and contain meta + parameters
Crossfade or bypass API smoke assertions exist for StateManager helpers
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add network or non-deterministic host-dependent tests

allowed: use Catch2 TEST_CASE sections matching prior tests style
build minimal APVTS or parameter map fixtures inline in the test file
locate presets relative to source tree or binary via juce File helpers
forbidden: re-implement profile tables inside the test file as production source of truth
require GUI/message-thread to run unit tests
